title.narrative: Climate Change Education and Mitigation in primary schools in Guangdong Province, China

description.narrative: Zhongshan City is located in the Pearl River Delta Region of Guangdong Province in China. Even though the government acknowledges the need for climate education, this is still short-coming compared to other low carbon initiatives. The project promoted climate change education and emissions reduction in primary schools in Zhongshan City. The organisation trained teachers and developed training materials for children’s needs. This lead to 212 primary schools benefitting from the climate change education project in Zhongshan City. Further NGOs and teachers outside the city had access to the training materials.
